methods.name: L-MAP
methods.description: Proposed method evaluated on continuous control tasks with stochasticity

methods.name: 1R2R
methods.description: A risk-averse model-based algorithm specifically designed for stochastic domains

methods.name: Latent Macro Action Planner (L-MAP)
methods.description: Leverages temporal abstractions learned with a state-conditioned VQ-VAE to construct a discrete latent space of macro-actions for planning in high-dimensional continuous action spaces within stochastic environments.

methods.name: state-conditioned VQ-VAE
methods.description: Framework used to learn temporal abstractions, capture essential dynamics, and reconstruct return-to-go estimates via a decoder.

methods.name: TT (+Q)
methods.description: Trajectory planning method requiring sampling with a separate Q-network.

methods.name: CompILE
methods.description: learns latent codes representing variable-length behavior segments, enabling cross-task generalization

methods.name: RPL
methods.description: employs a hierarchical policy architecture to simplify long-horizon tasks by decomposing them into sub-policies

methods.name: OPAL
methods.description: introduces a continuous space of primitive actions to reduce distributional shift in offline RL, enhancing policy robustness

methods.name: PRISE
methods.description: applies sequence compression to learn variable-length action primitives, improving behavior cloning by capturing essential behavioral patterns

methods.name: Behavior Cloning (BC)
methods.description: Additional baseline method included since the original 1R2R method was not evaluated for Adroit tasks

methods.name: MCTS process for macro-level planning
methods.description: Iteratively selects actions using the UCT policy, applies progressive widening to balance exploration and exploitation, performs parallel expansion of multiple macro actions and their potential outcomes, and backpropagates estimated Q-values to explore and refine the planning tree.

methods.name: progressive widening
methods.description: Extends MCTS to incrementally expand the search tree, balancing the exploration of new states with the exploitation of already visited states.

methods.name: UCT policy
methods.description: Policy used for iterative action selection in MCTS.
